common_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one standalone small educational decorative cutout for the corner of a printable feedback slip. Subject: SUBJECT. Style: simple friendly editorial line illustration, crisp dark outlines, sparse muted blue and teal accents, few details, little ink coverage, readable at 20 mm and in grayscale. Complete centered silhouette with transparent margins. Genuinely transparent alpha background; pixels outside the illustrated objects must have zero alpha. Flat illustration only, NO glow, halo, vignette, gradient, shadow, background color, white rectangle or drawn checkerboard. No text, numbers, letters, faces, logos, watermark, trophies, scores or grades. Not a UI, full card, worksheet or page. Only the requested objects.
